note: Before 1933, the data covers only the states that registered deaths.
title: Share of deaths by cause in the United States since 1900
subtitle: Share of all deaths in each group of causes, based on the [underlying cause](#dod:underlying-cause-of-death) listed on [death certificates](#dod:crvs). “All other causes” includes everything else, such as chronic lung disease, Alzheimer’s disease, kidney disease, other infections, and COVID-19.
